decisions.reason: Identifies dsh web host PID 42432 as holder of koffi.node; loaded image is held open until process exit so npm copyfile fails EBUSY.
Refresh reloads only the SPA and cannot free the host-held handle; ordered stop both dsh processes → verify gone → install → verify → restart host.
Bare name follows latest=0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha.5 sits only on alpha tag, downgrading the running alpha.4; explicitly notes no preservation of installed version.
Gives npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 with TUI (pinned placeholder plus split fallback), verify dsh --version is alpha.5, then restart dsh web.
Advises READMEs to pin the exact host version on any install that also installs dsh and route prereleases to their tag instead of latest.
